_note: Hats, not accounts. One account may hold several; every chain event stamps its hat. Sessions here are SEEDED stubs (no real auth yet): signing in as a hat sets vc_hat + vc_session cookies to these ids. Identities are hashed on chain; only the owner sees their own name.

manufacturer.label: Manufacturer
manufacturer.blurb: Sees the product after the loading dock for the first time: which store sold which box, when it opened, where the hits landed.

distributor.label: Distributor
distributor.blurb: Pallets, lanes, regions. Tamper before sale is traced to a shipment, not a rumor.

retailer.label: Retailer
retailer.blurb: Counter-seal in under a minute. Every box leaves verifiable; a returned box with a broken seal is an opened box.

collector.label: Collector
collector.blurb: One tap claims the box. Every pack and every card attaches to the chain as it comes out.

seller.label: Seller
seller.verb: Resold it with the chain attached
seller.blurb: Tap-to-list: the listing's proof is the chain. A counterfeit has no chain to show.

grader.label: Grader
grader.blurb: Intake compares the scan to the unboxing fingerprint: same card, no trim, before the slab.
